risk_summary: The disclosure identifies material financial distress, including the shutdown of the clinic business, more than $30 million of related obligations, and reliance on debt restructuring and equity conversion. The replacement cloud-computing and AI businesses remain early-stage and are described with substantial aspirational language but limited operating or financial performance data. Repeated boilerplate and a truncated results section reduce transparency regarding current liquidity, revenue generation, and execution risk.
